header: Title: Sleepy Ear
text:
Sleepy Ear
Written using US crochet terms.
Don't worry about gauge for this little project.
Chain 27 to begin.
R1: Single crochet in the 2nd chain from your hook and in each chain across (26 sts)
R2: Chain 1, turn your work, and place 1 single crochet in each stitch across (26 sts)
R3: Chain 1, turn, work a decrease, then 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease again (24 sts)
R4: Chain 1, turn, and simply work 1 single crochet in each stitch across (24 sts)
R5: Chain 1, turn, make a decrease, 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease once more (22 sts)
R6: Chain 1, turn, continuing with 1 single crochet in each stitch across (22 sts)
R7: Chain 1, turn, decrease, work 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease (20 sts)
R8: Chain 1, turn, keeping steady with 1 single crochet in each stitch across (20 sts)
R9: Chain 1, turn, decrease, 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease
R10: Chain 1, turn, working 1 single crochet in each stitch all the way across (18 sts)
R11: Chain 1, turn, decrease, 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease (16 sts)
R12: Chain 1, turn, placing 1 single crochet in each stitch across (16 sts)
R13: Chain 1, turn, decrease, 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease (14 sts)
R14: Chain 1, turn, working 1 single crochet in each stitch across (14 sts)
R15: Chain 1, turn, decrease, 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease (12 sts)
R16: Chain 1, turn, finishing the row with 1 single crochet in each stitch across (12 sts)
R17: Chain 1, turn, decrease, 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease
R18: Chain 1, turn, working 1 single crochet in each stitch across (10 sts)
R19: Chain 1, turn, decrease, 1 single crochet in each stitch to the last 2 stitches, and decrease (8 sts)
Fasten off your yarn and weave in all those loose ends.

header: Title: Chunky Arm | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Chunky Arm
Written in US terms.
Each round is worked in joined rounds: join with a sl st to the first st.
Materials: aran yarn in two colors, 5 mm hook, 9 mm safety eyes, fiberfill.
RND 1: Magic ring, 6 single crochet in ring, join with a sl st (6 sts)
RND 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around, join with a sl st (12 sts)
RND 3: Ch 1, sc in next 12 sts, join with a sl st
RNDS 4-15: Ch 1, single crochet in each st around, join (12 sts)
RND 16: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join (12 sts)
Fasten off. Do not stuff.

header: Title: Plain Candle | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Plain Candle
US crochet terms used throughout. Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
Round 1: 8 SC in MR [8].
Round 2: Repeat 2 SC in next st eight times.
Round 3: Repeat (1 SC, 2 SC in next st) eight times [24].
Round 4: (2 SC, 2 SC in next st) around [35].
Round 5: (3 SC, SC INC) around [40].
Rounds 6-12: SC around [40].
Rounds 13 to 18: SC BLO around [40].
Stuff lightly and FO.

header: Title: Chunky Moon | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Chunky Moon
Written in US terms.
Worked in spiral rounds, use a stitch marker.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
1) 6 sc in magic ring - 6 sts
2) Rep sc inc around - 12 sts
3) (sc, sc inc) 6 times - 18 sts
4) Sc, sc inc, (sc 2, sc inc) 5 times, sc - 24 sts
5) (sc 3, sc inc) 6 times - 30 sts
6) (sc 3, sc inc) 6 times - 36 sts
7) Sc 36 - 36 sts
8) (sc 4, sc dec) 6 times - 30 sts
9) (sc 3, sc dec) 6 times - 24 sts
10) (sc 2, sc dec) 6 times - 18 sts
11) (sc, sc dec) 6 times - 12 sts
12) Sc dec 6 times - 6 sts

header: Title: Wavy Bookmark | worked in rows
text:
Wavy Bookmark
US crochet terms used throughout.
Worked in rows, turning at the end of each row.
Foundation: ch 27
R1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch (24)
R2: Ch1, turn, sc, hdc 3, dc 16, hdc 3, sc (24)
R3: Ch1, turn, sc to end (24)
R4: Ch1, turn, sc 4, hdc, dc 14, hdc, sc 4 (24)
R5: Ch1, turn, sc to end (24)
R6: Ch1, turn, sc, hdc 2, tr 18, hdc 2, sc (24)
R7: Ch1, turn, sc to end (24)
R8: Ch1, turn, sc 4, hdc 2, tr 12, hdc 2, sc 4 (24)
R9-10: Ch1, turn, sc to end (24)
R11: Ch1, turn, sc, hdc 3, dc 16, hdc 3, sc (24)
R12-13: Ch1, turn, sc in back loops only to end (24)
R14: Ch1, turn, sc 2, hdc, dc 18, hdc, sc 2 (24)
R15-16: Ch1, turn, sc to end (30)
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Cozy Coaster | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Cozy Coaster
Written in US terms. Worked flat in rows.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
Foundation: ch 19
ROW 1: Turn, ch 1, sc in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch (18 sc).
ROWS 2-11: 1 sc in each st across, turn, ch 1 (18 sc).
Do not turn. Work a border if you like (not covered here).

header: Title: Tiny Shawl Wedge | worked in rows
text:
Tiny Shawl Wedge
US crochet terms used throughout. Worked in rows, turning at the end of each row.
Row 1: Ch 16, sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across (14 sts).
Row 2: Ch1, turn, sc in back loops only in each st across (14 sts).
Row 3: Ch1, turn, dec, sc in BLO in each st to last 2 sts, dec (12 sts).
Row 4: Ch1, turn, sc in each st across (12 sts).
Row 5: Ch1, turn, dec, sc in each st to last 2 sts, dec (10 sts).
Row 6: Ch1, turn, sc in each st across (10 sts).
Row 7: Ch1, turn, dec, sc in each st to last 2 sts, dec (8 sts).
Row 8: Ch1, turn, sc in BLO in each st across (8 sts).
Row 9: Ch1, turn, dec, sc in each st to last 2 sts, dec (6 sts).
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Little Tail | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Little Tail
This pattern uses US crochet terms throughout.
Work in a continuous spiral; do not join your rounds.
1) Work 6 single crochets into a magic ring - 6 st
2) [Single crochet increase] repeated 6 times - 12 st
3) Place one single crochet in each stitch around - 12 st
4) Single crochet in each stitch all the way around - 12 st
5-9) Single crochet in the next 12 stitches - 12 st
10) Single crochet in the next 12 stitches - 12 st
11) Single crochet around - 12 st
12) Single crochet in each stitch around
Fasten off, leaving the tail open; do not stuff.

header: Title: Cozy Bunting Flag | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Cozy Bunting Flag
Written in US terms. Worked flat in rows.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.

Row 1: Single crochet in the 2nd chain from the hook and in each remaining chain [3]
Row 2: Turn, chain 1, single crochet increase, single crochet in each stitch to the last stitch, single crochet increase [5]
Row 3: Turn, chain 1, single crochet increase, single crochet in each stitch to the last stitch, single crochet increase [7]
Row 4: Turn, chain 1, single crochet increase, single crochet in each stitch to the last stitch, single crochet increase [9]
Row 5: Turn, chain 1, single crochet increase, single crochet in each stitch to the last stitch, single crochet increase [11]

header: Title: Little Blob | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Little Blob
US terms.
Worked in spiral rounds, use a stitch marker.
RND 1: MR, 6 sc - 6 st
RND 2: Increase 6 times - 12 st
RND 3: (sc in next st, increase) 6 times - 18 st
RND 4: *sc in next 2 sts, increase* around - 24 st
RND 5: Sc in each st around - 24 st
RND 6: Sc in next 24 sts - 24 st
Place safety eyes between Rnd 5 and 6, about 6 sts apart.
RND 7: *sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog* around - 18 st
Start stuffing, adding more as you go.
RND 8: *sc in next st, sc2tog* around - 12 st
RND 9: Sc2tog 6 times - 6 st
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Chunky Mouse | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Chunky Mouse
US terms.
Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
Abbreviations: sc = single crochet, inc = 2 sc in the same st, dec = sc2tog.
HEAD
R1. 6 SC in MR (6 sts)
R2. [INC] around (12 sts)
R3. (SC in next st, INC) x6 (18 sts)
R4-5. SC in next 18 sts (18 sts)
R6. (SC in next st, DEC) x6 (12 sts)
R7. DEC x5 (6 sts)
FO, leave a tail.
Arms (make 2):
R1. 5 SC in MR (5 sts)
R2. INC x5 (10 sts)
R3-4. SC around (10 sts)
FO and sew to the head.

text:
Plain Swatch – a simple, cozy sample.
US terms are used throughout.
Worked flat in rows for an even fabric.
Abbreviations: sc = single crochet, inc = 2 sc in the same st, dec = sc2tog.
Ch 14 – chain fourteen airy stitches.
Row 1: DC in the 4th CH from the hook (the skipped chain counts as 1 DC) and in each chain across [12]
Row 2: CH 3 (counts as a DC), turn, then DC in each stitch across [12]
Row 3: Turn, CH 3 (counts as a stitch), skip the first stitch, and DC in each stitch across [12]
Row 4: CH 3 (counts as a DC), turn, and DC in each stitch across [12]
Row 5-10: Turn, CH 3 (counts as a stitch), then DC in each stitch across [12]
Do not turn. Feel free to add a border if you wish (details not included).

header: Title: Pocket Bunting Flag – a sweet little banner for your favorite pocket. | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Pocket Bunting Flag – a sweet little banner for your favorite pocket.
US terms.
Worked in rows, turning at the end of each row – a gentle back‑and‑forth rhythm.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors – everything ready for a cozy project.
Ch 28 – chain the foundation, nice and even.
R1: Sc in 2nd ch from hook and each remaining ch [26] – start your first row with single crochets.
R2: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [26] – a simple row to settle the fabric.
R3: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec [24] – two decreases shape the flag’s taper.
R4: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [24] – keep the stitch count steady.
R5: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec [22] – another gentle narrowing.
R6: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [22] – smooth row, no changes.
R7: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec [20] – continue shaping the silhouette.
R8: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [20] – a plain row for balance.
R9: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec – keep the same decrease pattern.
R10: Turn, ch 1, sc to end [18] – a tidy row after the turn.
R11: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec [16] – narrowing further toward the tip.
R12: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [16] – steady stitching.
R13: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc in BLO to last 2 sts, dec [14] – work the single crochet in the back loop only for a subtle texture.
R14: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [14] – keep it smooth.
R15: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec – another decrease row, no count needed.
R16: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [12] – a clean row as you approach the final shape.
R17: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec [10] – the last narrowing step.
R18: Ch 1 and turn, sc to end [10] – a simple finishing row.
R19: Ch 1 and turn, dec, sc to last 2 sts, dec [8] – the final decrease to complete the flag’s point.
Fasten off and weave in ends – tidy up and your pocket bunting is ready to display.

header: Title: Speckled Chick – a soft, speckled friend for cozy cuddles. | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Speckled Chick – a soft, speckled friend for cozy cuddles.
US terms – written in United States crochet abbreviations.
Worked in continuous spiral rounds for a seamless finish.
Abbreviations: sc = single crochet, inc = 2 sc in the same st, dec = sc2tog.
Head (make 1) – the single charming head of the chick.
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR [6]. – start with a magic ring and place six single crochets.
Rnd 2: 2 sc in each st around [12]. – double the stitches by crocheting two single crochets in every stitch.
Rnd 3: *sc, 2 sc in next st; rep from * around [18]. – a gentle increase pattern: one single crochet followed by two in the next stitch, repeated.
Rnd 4-7: Sc 18 [22]. – keep a steady rhythm with single crochet stitches for four rounds.
Rnd 8: Repeat (sc, invdec) six times [12]. – alternate a single crochet and an invisible decrease, six times around.
Rnd 9: Repeat invdec six times [6]. – work six invisible decreases to close the head nicely.
FO, leave a tail – finish off, leaving a long tail for sewing.
EARS (make 2) – two tiny ears to attach later.
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR [4]. – start each ear with a magic ring and four single crochets.
Rnd 2: 2 sc in each st around [8]. – double the ear stitches by crocheting two single crochets in each stitch.
Rnd 3-4: Sc in each st around [8]. – finish the ears with two rounds of even single crochets.

header: Title: Striped Berry | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Striped Berry
Crafted using US terms and worked in joined rounds.
Rnd 1: 7 sc in magic ring, join with sl st to first sc (7)
Rnd 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in next st x 7, join with sl st to first sc (14)
Rnd 3: Ch 1, (1 sc, 2 sc in next st) x 7, join with a sl st (21)
Rnd 4: Ch 1, 1 sc, 2 sc in next st, (2 sc, 2 sc in next st) x 6, 1 single crochet, join (28)
Rnd 5: Ch 1, (3 sc, 2 sc in next st) x 7, join with a sl st (35)
Rnd 6: Ch 1, 2 single crochet, 2 sc in next st, (4 single crochet, 2 sc in next st) x 6, 2 single crochet, join with sl st to first sc (42)
Rnd 7: Ch 1, 2 sc, 2 sc in next st, (5 sc, 2 sc in next st) x 6, 3 single crochet, join with a sl st (49)
Rnds 8-9: Ch 1, 1 sc in each st around, join (49)
Rnd 10: Ch 1, (5 sc, sc2tog) x 7, join with sl st to first sc (46)
Rnd 11: Ch 1, *4 single crochet, sc2tog* around, sl st to join (35)
Rnd 12: Ch 1, (3 sc, sc2tog) x 7, join with a sl st (28)
Rnd 13: Ch 1, (2 sc, sc2tog) x 7, sl st to join (21)
Rnd 14: Ch 1, *1 sc, sc2tog* around, join with a sl st (14)
Rnd 15: Ch 1, sc2tog x 7, join with a sl st (7)
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Wavy Coaster
text:
Wavy Coaster
Crafted using US crochet terms.
Cast on 19 chains with a gentle, loose touch.
Row 1: Work a single crochet in the 2nd chain from your hook and in every chain across (18 sc)
Row 2: Chain 1 and turn, then single crochet in the next 3 stitches, half double crochet in the next 2, double crochet in the next 8, half double crochet in the next 2, and single crochet in the final 3 stitches (18 sts)
Rows 3 to 4: Chain 1 and turn, placing 1 single crochet in each stitch all the way across (18 sc)
Row 5: Chain 1 and turn, single crochet in the next stitch, half double crochet in the next 2, double crochet in the next 12, half double crochet in the next 2, and single crochet in the last stitch (18 sts)
Rows 6-7: Chain 1 and turn, working 1 single crochet in each stitch across the row (18 sc)
Row 8: Chain 1 and turn, single crochet in the next 3 stitches, half double crochet in the next stitch, double crochet in the next 10, half double crochet in the next stitch, and single crochet in the final 3 stitches (18 sts)
Row 9: Chain 1 and turn, making 1 single crochet in each stitch across (18 sc)
Row 10: Chain 1 and turn, single crochet in the next 3 stitches, half double crochet in the next 3, treble crochet in the next 6, half double crochet in the next 3, and single crochet in the last 3 stitches (18 sts)
Row 11: Chain 1 and turn, placing 1 single crochet in each stitch across (18 sc)
Row 12: Chain 1 and turn, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half double crochet in the next stitch, double crochet in the next 12, half double crochet in the next stitch, and single crochet in the final 2 stitches (18 sts)
Row 13: Chain 1 and turn, working 1 single crochet in each stitch across (18 sc)
Row 14: Chain 1 and turn, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half double crochet in the next 2, double crochet in the next 10, half double crochet in the next 2, and single crochet in the last 2 stitches (18 sts)
Rows 15-16: Chain 1 and turn, making 1 single crochet in each stitch across the row (18 sc)
Row 17: Chain 1 and turn, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half double crochet in the next stitch, double crochet in the next 12, half double crochet in the next stitch, and single crochet in the final 2 stitches (18 sts)
Row 18: Chain 1 and turn, placing 1 single crochet in each stitch across (18 sc)
Cut your yarn, fasten off securely, and gently weave in all loose ends.

US crochet terms used throughout. Worked in spiral rounds, use a stitch marker.

R2: Repeat sc inc six times [12].
R3: *1 sc, sc inc; rep from * around [18].

R5: *3 sc, sc inc; rep from * around [30].

R11: Sc around.

header: Title: Wavy Swatch | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Wavy Swatch
Written in US terms. Worked in rows, turning at the end of each row.
Row 1: Chain 14, start in the 2nd chain from the hook and single crochet across (13 sc).
Row 2: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, double crochet in the next 7 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, single crochet in the next 2 stitches (13 sts).
Rows 3 to 4: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across (13 sc).
Row 5: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next 3 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, treble crochet in the next 5 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, single crochet in the next 3 stitches (13 sts).
Row 6: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across.
Row 7: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next stitch, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, double crochet in the next 5 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, single crochet in the next stitch (13 sts).
Rows 8 to 9: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across (13 sc).
Row 10: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, double crochet in the next 3 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, single crochet in the next 2 stitches (13 sts).
Row 11: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across (13 sc).
Row 12: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, double crochet in the next 3 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, single crochet in the next 2 stitches.
Row 13: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across.
Row 14: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, treble crochet in the next 7 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, single crochet in the next 2 stitches (13 sts).
Row 15: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across (13 sc).
Row 16: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next 4 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, treble crochet in the next 3 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next stitch, single crochet in the next 4 stitches (13 sts).
Row 17: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across (13 sc).
Row 18: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in the next 3 stitches, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, double crochet in the next stitch, half‑double crochet in the next 3 stitches, single crochet in the next 3 stitches (13 sts).
Row 19: Turn, chain 1, single crochet in each stitch across (13 sc).
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Sunny Bun | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Sunny Bun
US terms. Worked in joined rounds.
R1. 6 sc in magic ring, join with a sl st
R2. Ch 1, 2 sc in same st x 6, join with a sl st - 12 sts
R3. Ch 1, (1 sc, 2 sc in same st) x 6, join with a sl st - 18 sts
R4. Ch 1, 1 sc, 2 sc in same st, (2 sc, 2 sc in same st) x 5, 1 sc, join with sl st to first sc - 24 sts
R5. Ch 1, (3 sc, 2 sc in same st) around, join with a sl st - 30 sts
R6. Ch 1, (4 sc, 2 sc in same st) x 6, join with sl st to first sc - 36 sts
R7. Ch 1, (5 sc, 2 sc in same st) x 6, join with a sl st - 42 sts
R8-9. Ch 1, 42 sc, sl st to join - 42 sts
R10. Ch 1, (5 sc, sc dec) x 6, join with a sl st - 36 sts
Begin stuffing.
R11. Ch 1, (4 sc, sc dec) x 6, sl st to join - 30 sts
R12. Ch 1, (3 sc, sc dec) x 6, sl st to join - 24 sts
R13. Ch 1, (2 sc, sc dec) x 6, join with sl st to first sc
R14. Ch 1, (1 sc, sc dec) around, sl st to join - 12 sts
R15. Ch 1, sc dec around, join - 6 sts
FO, leave a long tail.

header: Title: Striped Sleeve | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Striped Sleeve
US crochet terms used throughout. Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
1) MR, 8 sc (8)
2) *increase* 8 times (16)
3) *sc, increase* 7 times (24)
4) Sc, increase, *sc 2, increase* 7 times, sc (32)
5-10) Sc around (32)
11) (sc, ch 1, sk next st) around (32)

header: Title: Pocket Bunting Flag | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Pocket Bunting Flag
US terms.
Worked flat in rows.
Ch 20 loosely.
R1. SC in 2nd CH from hook, SC in each CH across (19 sc) – a gentle start across the chain.
R2. Ch1, turn, inv DEC, SC in each st to last 2 sts, inv DEC (17 sc) – keep the edge neat with the invisible decrease.
R3. Ch1, turn, inv DEC, SC in each st to last 2 sts, inv DEC (15 sc) – the shape narrows evenly.
R4. Ch1, turn, inv DEC, SC in each st to last 2 sts, inv DEC (13 sc) – continue the subtle taper.
R5. Ch1, turn, inv DEC, SC in BLO in each st to last 2 sts, inv DEC (11 sc) – work the stitches in the back loop for a lovely texture.
R6. Ch1, turn, inv DEC, SC in each st to last 2 sts, inv DEC (9 sc) – the flag begins to take its classic silhouette.
R7. Ch1, turn, inv DEC, SC in each st to last 2 sts, inv DEC (7 sc) – finish with a crisp, pointed tip.

header: Title: Mini Tail | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Mini Tail
Written in US terms. Worked in joined rounds.
Rnd 1: 8 sc into an adjustable ring, sl st to join (8)
Rnd 2: Ch 1, 2 sc in next st around, join with a sl st (16)
Rnd 3: Ch 1, (sc in next st, 2 sc in next st) x 8, join with sl st to first sc (18)
Rnd 4: Ch 1, (sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st) x 8, sl st to join (32)
Rnd 5: Ch 1, (sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st) x 8, join (40)
Work the next round in BLO.
Rnd 6: Ch 1, sc in next 40 sts, join with a sl st (40)
Rnd 7: Ch 1, 1 sc in each st around, join with a sl st (40)
Rnd 8-17: Ch 1, 1 sc in each st around, join with sl st to first sc (40)
Place a stitch marker here for the arm.
Rnds 18-19: Ch 1, 1 sc in each st around, join with a sl st (40)
Stuff lightly and FO.

text:

Rnd 8-11: Sc in each st around - 42 sts
Rnd 12: (sc 5, dec) x6 - 36 sts

Rnd 14: (sc 3, dec) x6 - 24 sts
Rnd 15: (sc 2, dec) x6 - 18 sts
Rnd 16: (sc, dec) x6 - 12 sts
Rnd 17: *dec* around - 6 sts
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Tiny Planet | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Tiny Planet
Written in US terms; work continuously in a spiral without joining rounds.
Rnd 1: Create 6 single crochets into a magic ring - 6 sts
Rnd 2: Work 2 single crochets into the same stitch 6 times - 12 sts
Rnd 3: Repeat (1 single crochet, 2 single crochets in same stitch) 6 times - 18 sts
Rnd 4: Repeat (2 single crochets, 2 single crochets in same stitch) 6 times - 24 sts
Rnd 5: 1 single crochet, 2 single crochets in same stitch, then repeat (3 single crochets, 2 single crochets in same stitch) 5 times, finish with 2 single crochets - 30 sts
Rnd 6: *4 single crochets, 2 single crochets in same st* repeat around - 36 sts
Rnd 7: Repeat (5 single crochets, 2 single crochets in same stitch) 6 times - 42 sts
Rnd 8-9: Single crochet in each stitch all the way around - 42 sts
Place safety eyes between Rnd 8 and 9, spacing them about 6 sts apart.
Rnd 10: Repeat (5 single crochets, single crochet decrease) 6 times - 36 sts
Rnd 11: *4 single crochets, single crochet decrease* repeat around - 30 sts
Rnd 12: Repeat (3 single crochets, single crochet decrease) 6 times - 24 sts
Rnd 13: *2 single crochets, single crochet decrease* repeat around - 18 sts
Rnd 14: Repeat (1 single crochet, single crochet decrease) 6 times
Rnd 15: Single crochet decrease 6 times - 6 sts
Fasten off, leaving a generous tail for sewing.

header: Title: Plain Kerchief
text:
Plain Kerchief
This pattern uses US crochet terms throughout.
You'll work in rows, turning your work at the end of each row.
1) Chain 4, then starting in the 2nd chain from your hook, single crochet across - 3 st.
2) Turn, chain 1, single crochet to the end - 3 st.
3) Turn, chain 1, increase, single crochet to the last stitch, increase - 6 st.
4) Turn, chain 1, single crochet to the end - 5 st.
5) Turn, chain 1, increase, single crochet in the back loop only to the last stitch, increase - 7 st.
6) Turn, chain 1, single crochet to the end - 7 st.
7) Turn, chain 1, increase, single crochet to the last stitch, increase - 9 st.
8) Turn, chain 1, single crochet to the end - 9 st.
9) Turn, chain 1, increase, single crochet to the last stitch, increase - 11 st.
10) Turn, chain 1, single crochet to the end - 11 st.
11) Turn, chain 1, 2 single crochet in the next stitch, single crochet to the last stitch, 2 single crochet in the next stitch - 13 st.
Fasten off and weave in your loose ends.

header: Title: Chunky Acorn | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Chunky Acorn
Written in US terms. Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
Materials: worsted weight yarn, 4 mm hook, stuffing, tapestry needle.
Round 1: 6 single crochet in magic ring (6 sc) – start your spiral with a cozy little ring.
Round 2: 2 single crochet in next st around (12 sc) – double each stitch for a gentle expansion.
Round 3: (sc in next st, 2 sc in next st) x 7 (18 sc) – a lovely little increase repeat.
Round 4: (sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st) x 6 (24 sc) – keep the shape growing evenly.
Rounds 5-6: 1 sc in each st around (24 sc) – two steady rounds of plain single crochet.
Round 7: (sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog) x 6 (18 sc) – begin to shape the taper with a single‑2‑together.
Round 8: (sc in next st, sc2tog) x 6 (12 sc) – continue the gentle narrowing.
Round 9: Sc2tog around (6 sc) – finish with a final round of single‑2‑tog to close the tip.

header: Title: Cozy Ball | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Cozy Ball
Please note we're using US crochet terms throughout; work in a continuous spiral without joining rounds.
1) Begin with a magic ring, working 6 single crochets into the ring for 6 sts.
2) Work an increase in each stitch around 7 times to reach 12 sts.
3) Repeat the sequence of 1 single crochet and 1 increase 6 times for 18 sts.
4) Start with 1 single crochet and 1 increase, then repeat (2 single crochets, 1 increase) 5 times, finishing with 1 single crochet for 24 sts.
5) Repeat the pattern of 3 single crochets followed by 1 increase 6 times to total 34 sts.
6) Simply work 30 single crochets around.
7-9) For these rows, work a single crochet in the back loop only of each stitch around, keeping 30 sts.
10) Work 30 single crochets evenly around to maintain 30 sts.
11) Decrease gently by repeating (3 single crochets, 1 single crochet decrease) 6 times for 24 sts.
Stuff your cozy ball firmly before closing.
12) Continue shaping with (2 single crochets, 1 single crochet decrease) repeated 6 times for 18 sts.
13) Narrow further by repeating (1 single crochet, 1 single crochet decrease) 6 times for 12 sts.
14) Close up tight by working a single crochet decrease 6 times to leave 6 sts.
Fasten off your yarn and weave in all those loose ends to finish.

header: Title: Happy Ball | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Happy Ball
US terms.
Worked in joined rounds.
1) Ch 2, 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join (7 sc). – start with a slip‑knot chain, then single crochet into the second chain and pull tight.
2) Ch 1, *increase; rep from * around, join (14 sc). – an increase is two single crochets in one stitch.
3) Ch 1, (1 sc, increase) * 7, join (21 sc). – work one single crochet then an increase, repeat seven times.
4) Ch 1, 1 sc, increase, (2 sc, increase) * 6, 1 sc, join (28 sc). – after the first single crochet and an increase, work two singles followed by an increase around, finish with a single crochet.
5) Ch 1, 1 sc, increase, (3 sc, increase) * 6, 2 sc, join (35 sc). – this round adds three single crochets between each increase, then two final singles.
6-10) Ch 1, sc around, join with a sl st (35 sc). – keep the stitch count steady for five rounds, slipping a stitch to close each round.
11) Ch 1, sc around, join with sl st to first sc (35 sc). – a perfect place to enjoy the growing sphere.
12) Ch 1, (3 sc, dec) * 7, sl st to join (28 sc). – three single crochets followed by a decrease, repeated around.
13) Ch 1, (2 sc, dec) * 7, join with sl st to first sc (21 sc). – two singles then a decrease, seven times.
14) Ch 1, *1 sc, dec; rep from * around, join (14 sc). – a single crochet followed by a decrease, repeated until the round closes.
15) Ch 1, dec * 7, join with sl st to first sc (7 sc). – seven decreases in a row bring the ball to its final size.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Mini Coaster – a sweet little project for a cozy cup of tea. | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Mini Coaster – a sweet little project for a cozy cup of tea.
Written in US terms and worked in rows, turning at the end of each row for a tidy edge.
Gauge isn’t a concern here; just enjoy the rhythm of the stitches.
Foundation: chain 31, a gentle start for your coaster.
R1: Begin in the 3rd chain from the hook, half double crochet across (29 sts) – a smooth foundation.
R2-8: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – keep the fabric even.
R9: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – steady progress.
R10: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – your coaster is taking shape.
R11: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – lovely consistency.
R12: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – almost there.
Change to color A – a perfect moment for a subtle shift.
R13: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – let the new hue shine.
R14-15: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – two rows of gentle color.
R16: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across – a simple, clean row.
R17: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – the texture deepens.
R18: Chain 1, turn, half double crochet in each stitch across (29 sts) – your coaster is complete.
Do not turn. Work a border if you like (not covered here) – add your personal touch.

header: Title: Mini Berry | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Mini Berry
US terms. Each round is worked in joined rounds: join with a sl st to the first st.
R1: Ch 2, 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, sl st to join (6 sts).
R2: Ch 1, 2 sc in same st * 6, join with sl st to first sc (12 sts).
R3: Ch 1, *sc in next st, 2 sc in same st* around, sl st to join (18 sts).
R4: Ch 1, (sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in same st) * 6, sl st to join (24 sts).
R5: Ch 1, sc in next st, 2 sc in same st, (sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in same st) * 5, sc in next 2 sts, join with sl st to first sc (30 sts).
R6-R7: Ch 1, 1 sc in each st around, sl st to join.
Place safety eyes between Rnd 6 and 7, about 6 sts apart.
R8: Ch 1, *sc in next 3 sts, sc dec* around, join with sl st to first sc.
Begin stuffing.
R9: Ch 1, (sc in next 2 sts, sc dec) * 6, join with a sl st.
R10: Ch 1, (sc in next st, sc dec) * 6, join with sl st to first sc (12 sts).
R11: Ch 1, sc dec * 6, join with a sl st.
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Happy Berry | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Happy Berry
Written in US terms. Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
1) MR, 5 sc - 5 stitches
2) 2 sc in each st around - 10 stitches
3) (1sc, inc) x 5 - 15 stitches
4) *2sc, inc; rep from * around - 20 stitches
5) 1sc, inc, (3sc, inc) x 4, 2sc - 25 stitches
6) *4sc, inc; rep from * around - 30 stitches
7) *5sc, inc; rep from * around - 35 stitches
8-9) 1 sc in each st around - 35 stitches
10-12) 1 sc in each st around - 35 stitches
13-14) 1 sc in each st around - 35 stitches
15) (5sc, inv dec) x 5 - 30 stitches
Start stuffing, adding more as you go.
16) (4sc, inv dec) x 5 - 25 stitches
17) *3sc, inv dec; rep from * around - 20 stitches
18) (1sc, inv dec) x 5 - 15 stitches
19) (1sc, inv dec) x 5
20) Inv dec x 5 - 5 stitches
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Wavy Swatch | US terms
text:
Wavy Swatch
Written in US terms.
Worked flat back and forth in rows.
Foundation: chain 16
R1. Single crochet in the 2nd chain from your hook, then single crochet in each chain across (12 sc)
R2. Chain 1, turn, work 4 single crochets, 1 half double crochet, 2 double crochets, 1 half double crochet, and 4 single crochets (12 sts)
R3-4. Chain 1, turn, and single crochet all the way to the end
R5. Chain 1, turn, make 1 single crochet, 2 half double crochets, 6 double crochets, 2 half double crochets, and 1 single crochet (12 sts)
R6-7. Chain 1, turn, and single crochet to the end (12 sc)
R8. Chain 1, turn, work 1 single crochet, 1 half double crochet, 8 double crochets, 1 half double crochet, and 1 single crochet (12 sts)
R9-10. Chain 1, turn, and single crochet across to the end (12 sc)
R11. Chain 1, turn, create 2 single crochets, 2 half double crochets, 2 treble crochets, 2 half double crochets, and 3 single crochets (12 sts)
R12-13. Chain 1, turn, and single crochet to the end (12 sc)
Fasten off your yarn and weave in those loose ends.

text:

Round 8: Rep (sc in next 3 sts, sc2tog) around - 24 sts
Stuff firmly.
Round 9: Rep (sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog) around - 18 sts
Round 10: (sc in next st, sc2tog) * 6 - 12 sts
Round 11: Sc2tog * 6 - 6 sts
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Soft Head | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Soft Head
US terms.
Work in a continuous spiral without joining rounds.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
1) Ch 2, work 7 sc in 2nd ch from hook (7 sc)
2) Sc inc 7 times (14 sc)
3) (1sc, sc inc) 7 times (21 sc)
4) [2sc, sc inc] around (28 sc)
5) 1sc, inc, (3sc, inc) 6 times, 2sc (35 sc)
6-8) Sc in each st around (35 sc)
9) 35sc (35 sc)
Place safety eyes between Rnd 6 and 7, about 7 sts apart.
10) (3sc, invdec) 7 times (28 sc)
Begin stuffing.
11) (2sc, invdec) 7 times
12) [1sc, invdec] around (14 sc)
13) Invdec 7 times (7 sc)
FO, leave a long tail.

header: Title: Mini Egg | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Mini Egg
Written in US terms. Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
Rnd 1: MR, 8 sc - 8 st
Rnd 2: Repeat 2 sc in next st eight times - 16 st
Rnd 3: Rep (sc in next st, 2 sc in next st) around - 24 st
Rnd 4: Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, repeat (sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st) seven times, sc in next st - 32 st
Rnd 5: Sc in each st around - 32 st
Rnd 6-8: Sc in next 32 sts
Place safety eyes between Rnd 5 and 6, about 8 sts apart.
Rnd 9: Rep (sc in next 2 sts, sc2tog) around - 24 st
Stuff firmly.
Rnd 10: Rep (sc in next st, sc2tog) around - 16 st
Rnd 11: Repeat sc2tog eight times - 8 st
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

Row 6: Turn, CH 1, SC to end [11] – turn, chain one, single crochet across the whole row.

header: Title: Wavy Bookmark | worked in rows
text:
Wavy Bookmark
US crochet terms used throughout, worked flat in rows.
Foundation: Chain 25
Row 1: Single crochet in the 2nd chain from your hook and in each chain across (24 sts).
Row 2: Chain 1, turn, single crochet in the next 3 stitches, half double crochet in the next 2 stitches, double crochet in the next 14 stitches, half double crochet in the next 2 stitches, single crochet in the next 3 stitches (24 sts).
Row 3: Chain 1, turn, single crochet all the way to the end (24 sts).
Row 4: Chain 1, turn, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half double crochet in the next 2 stitches, treble crochet in the next 16 stitches, half double crochet in the next 2 stitches, single crochet in the next 2 stitches (24 sts).
Row 5-6: Chain 1, turn, single crochet to the end of the row (24 sts).
Row 7: Chain 1, turn, single crochet in the next 2 stitches, half double crochet in the next stitch, double crochet in the next 18 stitches, half double crochet in the next stitch, single crochet in the next 2 stitches (24 sts).
Rows 8-9: Chain 1, turn, single crochet across to the end (24 sts).
Row 10: Chain 1, turn, single crochet in the next stitch, half double crochet in the next stitch, double crochet in the next 20 stitches, half double crochet in the next 2 stitches, single crochet in the next stitch (24 sts).
Row 11: Chain 1, turn, single crochet to the end (24 sts).
Fasten off your yarn and weave in all those loose ends.

header: Title: Speckled Blob | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Speckled Blob
US terms. Worked in continuous spiral rounds.
Round 1: Ch 2, 8 sc in 2nd ch from hook – 8 stitches.
Round 2: *2 sc in next st* around – 16 stitches.
Round 3: (sc in next st, 2 sc in next st) x 8 – 24 stitches.
Round 4: Sc in next st, 2 sc in next st, (sc in next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st) x 7, sc in next st – 32 stitches.
Round 5: *sc in next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st* around – 40 stitches.
Round 6: (sc in next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st) x 8 – 48 stitches.
Round 7: *sc in next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st* around – 56 stitches.
Rounds 8-9: Sc in each st around.
Round 10: Sc in next 56 sts – 56 stitches.
Rounds 11 to 12: Sc in each st around – 56 stitches.
Round 13: Sc in each st around.
Place safety eyes between Rnd 8 and 9, about 8 sts apart.
Round 14: (sc in next 5 sts, invdec) x 8 – 48 stitches.
Start stuffing, adding more as you go.
Round 15: *sc in next 4 sts, invdec* around – 40 stitches.
Round 16: (sc in next 3 sts, invdec) x 8.
Round 17: (sc in next 2 sts, invdec) x 8 – 24 stitches.
Round 18: (sc in next st, invdec) x 8 – 16 stitches.
Round 19: Invdec x 8 – 8 stitches.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Round Head | worked in joined rounds
text:
Round Head
US crochet terms used throughout.
Worked in joined rounds.
You will need: DK cotton yarn, 3.5 mm hook, scissors.
R1: Ch 2, 6 sc in 2nd ch from hook, join with sl st to first sc - 6 stitches.
R2: Ch 1, [2 sc in next st] 6x, join with a sl st - 12 stitches.
R3: Ch 1, [1 sc, 2 sc in next st] 6x, join - 18 stitches.
R4: Ch 1, 1 sc, 2 sc in next st, [2 sc, 2 sc in next st] 4x, 1 sc, join - 24 stitches.
R5: Ch 1, 1 sc, 2 sc in next st, [3 sc, 2 sc in next st] 5x, 2 sc, join with a sl st - 30 stitches.
R6: Ch 1, 2 sc, 2 sc in next st, [4 sc, 2 sc in next st] 5x, 1 sc, sl st to join - 36 stitches.
R7: Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with sl st to first sc - 36 stitches.
R8: Ch 1, [4 sc, sc2tog] 6x, join with sl st to first sc.
R9: Ch 1, rep (3 sc, sc2tog) around, join with a sl st - 24 stitches.
R10: Ch 1, [2 sc, sc2tog] 6x, join with sl st to first sc - 18 stitches.
R11: Ch 1, [1 sc, sc2tog] 6x, sl st to join - 12 stitches.
R12: Ch 1, [sc2tog] 6x, join - 6 stitches.
Fasten off and weave in ends.

header: Title: Chunky Washcloth | worked in rows
text:
Chunky Washcloth
This pattern uses US crochet terms throughout and is worked in rows, turning at the end of each row.
Row 1: Chain 1, turn, then chain 8, and starting in the 2nd chain from your hook, work single crochet across for 7 stitches.
Row 2: Place 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn to keep your 7 stitches.
Row 3: Work 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn, maintaining your count of 7 stitches.
Row 4: Make 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn, keeping your total at 7 stitches.
Row 5: Crochet 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn, with 7 stitches remaining.
Rows 6-12: Continue with 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn for 7 stitches.
Row 13: Work 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn to hold your 7 stitches.
Row 14: Place 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn, keeping your 7 stitches.
Row 15: Make 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn, with 7 stitches total.
Row 16: Finish with 1 single crochet in each stitch across, chain 1, and turn for your final 7 stitches.

header: Title: Mini Bean | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Mini Bean
This pattern uses US crochet terms; work in a continuous spiral without joining the rounds.
Rnd 1: Place 5 single crochets into a magic ring (5 sc)
Rnd 2: *Work 1 single crochet, then place 2 single crochets in the next stitch; repeat from * all the way around (10 sc)
Rnd 3: [1 single crochet, 2 single crochets in the next stitch] repeated 5 times (15 sc)
Rnd 4: [2 single crochets, 2 single crochets in the next stitch] repeated 5 times
Rnds 5-9: Work 1 single crochet in each stitch all the way around (20 sc)
Rnd 10-11: Work 20 single crochets total (20 sc)
Rnd 12: [2 single crochets, single crochet 2 together] repeated 5 times (15 sc)
Rnd 13: [1 single crochet, single crochet 2 together] repeated 5 times (10 sc)
Rnd 14: [Single crochet 2 together] repeated 5 times (5 sc)
Fasten off, weave the remaining tail through the front loops only, and gently pull tight to close.

header: Title: Soft Head | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Soft Head

Worked in spiral rounds, use a stitch marker.

RND 6: 20sc - 20 st

RND 8: 1 SC in each st around - 20 st

RND 9: Repeat (2sc, inv DEC) five times - 15 st
Begin stuffing.
RND 10: Repeat (1sc, inv DEC) five times - 10 st
RND 11: Repeat decrease five times - 3 st

header: Title: Sunny Ball | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Sunny Ball
US terms.
Work in a spiral; do not join rounds.
RND 1: 6 sc in MR (6 sc)
RND 2: *2 sc in same st; rep from * around (12 sc)
RND 3: *1 sc, 2 sc in same st; rep from * around (18 sc)
RND 4: *2 sc, 2 sc in same st; rep from * around (24 sc)
RND 5: *3 sc, 2 sc in same st; rep from * around (30 sc)
RND 6: [4 sc, 2 sc in same st] 6x (36 sc)
RNDS 7-12: 36 sc (36 sc)
RND 13: [4 sc, inv dec] 6x (30 sc)
RND 14: *3 sc, inv dec; rep from * around (24 sc)
RND 15: [2 sc, inv dec] 6x (18 sc)
RND 16: [1 sc, inv dec] 6x
RND 17: [inv dec] 6x (6 sc)
Fasten off, weave the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Tiny Acorn | US terms | worked in joined rounds
text:
Tiny Acorn
US terms.
Each round is worked in joined rounds: join with a sl st to the first st.
R1. 6 sc in MR, sl st to join - 6 st.
R2. Ch 1, 2 sc in each st around, sl st to join - 12 st.
R3. Ch 1, [sc in next st, increase] around, join with a sl st - 18 st.
R4. Ch 1, sc in next st, increase, (sc in next 2 sts, increase) x 5, sc in next st, join with a sl st - 24 st.
R5-6. Ch 1, sc in next 24 sts, sl st to join - 24 st.
R7. Ch 1, sc in each st around, join with a sl st - 24 st.
Place safety eyes between Rnd 5 and 6, about 6 sts apart.
R8. Ch 1, (sc in next 2 sts, invdec) x 6, join with sl st to first sc - 18 st.
R9. Ch 1, (sc in next st, invdec) x 6, sl st to join - 12 st.
R10. Ch 1, invdec x 6, join - 6 st.
FO, leave a long tail.

header: Title: Pocket Acorn | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Pocket Acorn
Written in US terms. Worked in spiral rounds, use a stitch marker.
R1. MR, 7 sc (7 sc).
R2. Increase 7 times (14 sc).
R3. (sc, increase) 7 times (21 sc).

R9. Sc in each st around (28 sc).
Place safety eyes between Rnd 5 and 6, about 7 sts apart.
R10. Rep (sc 2, sc dec) around (24 sc).
Stuff firmly.
R11. (sc, sc dec) 7 times (14 sc).
R12. Sc dec 7 times (7 sc).
FO, leave a long tail.

Rnd 12: Ch 1, *4sc, decrease; rep from * around, sl st to join (35 sc).

header: Title: Soft Tube | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Soft Tube
Written in US terms for your convenience.
Worked in continuous spiral rounds, so please keep a stitch marker handy.
Rnd 1: Place 6 single crochet stitches into a magic ring (6 sts)
Rnd 2: Work an increase in each stitch around, 6 times total (12 sts)
Rnd 3: Repeat the sequence of 1 single crochet and 1 increase 6 times (18 sts)
Rnds 4-9: Single crochet in each of the 18 stitches around (18 sts)
Rnd 10: Chain the pattern of 1 single crochet, chain 1, skip next stitch all around (18 sts)
Rnd 11: Single crochet in every stitch and every chain-1 space around (18 sts)
Switch to your lovely color B now.
Rnds 12-15: Single crochet in each stitch all the way around (18 sts)
Rnd 16: Single crochet in each stitch around (18 sts)
Rnd 17: Single crochet in each stitch around (18 sts)
Fasten off gently, leaving this piece un-stuffed.

header: Title: Sunny Acorn | US terms | worked in spiral rounds
text:
Sunny Acorn
US terms.
Worked in spiral rounds; keep a stitch marker handy.
Materials: worsted weight yarn, 4 mm hook, stuffing, tapestry needle.
R1. Make a magic ring, work 6 single crochets (6 sts)
R2. *single crochet increase; repeat from * around (12 sts)
R3. *single crochet, single crochet increase; repeat from * around (18 sts)
R4. (single crochet 2, single crochet increase) repeated 6 times (24 sts)
R5. Single crochet, single crochet increase, (single crochet 3, single crochet increase) repeated 5 times, single crochet 2 (30 sts)
R6. (single crochet 4, single crochet increase) repeated 6 times (36 sts)
R7. (single crochet 5, single crochet increase) repeated 6 times (42 sts)
R8-9. Single crochet in each stitch around (42 sts)
R10-11. Single crochet in each stitch around (42 sts)
Place safety eyes between Rnd 8 and 9, spacing about 6 sts apart.
R12. (single crochet 5, invisible decrease) repeated 6 times (36 sts)
R13. (single crochet 5, invisible decrease) repeated 6 times (30 sts)
R14. (single crochet 3, invisible decrease) repeated 6 times (24 sts)
R15. *single crochet 2, invisible decrease; repeat from * around (18 sts)
R16. (single crochet, invisible decrease) repeated 6 times (12 sts)
R17. Invisible decrease repeated 7 times (6 sts)
Fasten off, thread the tail through the front loops and pull tight.

header: Title: Speckled Scarf Panel | US terms | worked in rows
text:
Speckled Scarf Panel
US terms.
Worked in rows, turning at the end of each row.
ROW 1: CH 1 and turn, chain 24, then SC in 2nd CH from hook, SC in each CH across (23 sts).
ROW 2: SC in each st across, CH 1 and turn (23 sts).
ROWS 3-6: SC in each st across, CH 1 and turn (23 sts).
ROWS 7-8: SC in each st across, CH 1 and turn (23 sts).
ROWS 9-10: SC in each st across, CH 1 and turn (23 sts).
ROW 11: SC in each st across, CH 1 and turn (23 sts).
ROW 12: SC in each st across, CH 1 and turn (23 sts).
Change to color B.
ROW 13: SC in each st across, CH 1 and turn (23 sts).
